quote: A vehicle must not be driven to the left side of the highway at any time: When the view is obstructed upon approaching within 100 feet of any bridge, viaduct or tunnel. Subsection 2 does not apply upon a one-way highway.

activation.condition: Motor vehicle driver approaches a source-reviewed bridge on a public highway.

obligation.description: Do not drive to the left side of the highway while the stated bridge-approach and obstructed-view conditions apply.

exceptions.source_clause: Subsection 2 does not apply upon a one-way highway.

timing.description: Observe approach progression, body position, bridge entrance and original view geometry at common frames.

judgment_calls_needed.note: Qualitative source phrase; measured ray brackets and original pixels are retained without a legal cutoff.
